source: 2009 National Science Bowl High School Sample Set 1, Round 17
scope: Visually compared all 25 tossups and 25 bonuses, including complete prompts, printed answers, options, notes, and read-aloud text. Inspected all 13 source pages; paid particular attention to mathematical and chemical notation, states, charges, fractions, and subscripts/superscripts.
